notes.title: Full Release - v1.00
notes.content:
[h1]It gives us great pleasure to present to you: Version 1.00 of IMPOSSIBALL...[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/494d43c0c6b19325d41c3700553118668c24c073.jpg[/img]

Here's the change-list for this version:
[list]
[*] [b]Achievements added[/b]
[*] [b]Improved Controller Support[/b] (now support all popular controllers including: PS2, PS3, PS4, XBox 360, XBox One, Logitech, Executioner, MaxFire, Moga Pro, Natec and Ouya)
[*] [b]New and improved mouse control[/b] (the mouse moves a marker and the ship moves toward that marker)
[*] [b]Billboards[/b] added to the stadium :)
[*] [b]Stadium Crowd[/b] added
[*] [b]Cars added to the car park![/b]
[*] [b]New User Interface graphics[/b]
[*] [b]Menu Sound Effects[/b]
[*] [b]Balanced the AI for better game-play[/b]
[*] [b]BUG FIX[/b]: The mouse no longer interferes with the UI when using just a controller or keyboard
[*] [b]BUG FIX[/b]: In Loneball - sometimes the Power-Up was awarded to the wrong player
[*] [b]OPTIMISATION[/b]: Reduced the number of polygons in the balls to improve rendering times
[/list]

We will be moving out of Early Access as soon as possible and, as promised, the price of the game will increase - this is our way of saying THANK YOU for supporting us over the last 3 years!

We hope you enjoy the new version and, as always, we invite your feedback (the good and the bad) via the Discussion Forums.

Thanks again and happy gaming!

Dark Duo Games

notes.title: Version 1.0 is coming!!!
notes.content:
It's hard to believe that it has been almost 3 years since we created the Greenlight page for Impossiball - which is when we released the game on XBox360. The game has certainly evolved quite a bit since then:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/4848fbad2b410ab5afefad5ef017d233ff878410.gif[/img]

We are currently putting the finishing touches to the next update which will include achievements. You are already able to see the list of achievements on your game's page but you need to wait for the update before you can start unlocking them!

The update will also include:
[list]
[*] Better controller support - you will be able to play with PS2, PS3, PS4, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Logitech, Executioner, MaxFire, and more.
[*] New UI graphics
[*] Better mouse input
[*] Balanced difficulty settings making the game more fun to play against the AI
[*] ...and more!
[/list]

When we release this update we will also move out of Early Access and into Full Release. As we've said all along, we will increase the price when we move out of Early Access - this is our way of saying thank you for supporting us during the development of the game.

Thank you for your support and happy gaming!

Dark Duo Games

notes.title: Update 0.21 - Linux and Mac versions added
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/44f1d612c709ab75585688b1bee082e152dea4f2.jpg[/img]

IMPOSSIBALL is now available to gamers on Linux/SteamOS and Mac! As well as builds for the new platforms, this latest version includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] You can now re-map the keys for both player 1 and player 2 via the CONTROLS page. Just click on a key and you will be prompted to assign a new key.
[*] Added a new video option to turn on or off "VSync" - this limits the frame rate to the refresh rate of your monitor and reduces the load on your graphics card.
[*] When the cursor is hidden, the mouse is now locked in position - fixing a problem discovered on Linux
[*] Fixed the "mouse exploit" reported by Linas W. N. Sparrow - you can no longer move the mouse up and down quickly to create an impenetrable wall
[/list]

With regards to the last item in that list - the fix required us to limit the speed at which you can move the ship with the mouse. This is necessary to make it fair when playing against someone else using either the keyboard or a controller. It takes a little getting used to but, hopefully, you will understand that it was a necessary step.

We would like to thank all the Linux beta testers that were recruited via [url=gamingonlinux.com]GamingOnLinux.com[/url]

As always, we encourage your feedback and suggestions.

Happy gaming,

Dark Duo Games

notes.title: Version 0.2 Introduces a third game mode: LONEBALL
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/2a15f18444c79ae6274859626c8a27a659c17574.jpg[/img]

After feedback from the community we've created a classic pong mode entitled 'Loneball'. There's a single ball retro-ed up with neon effects and a chiptune soundtrack.

Here's the full list of changes included in the update:
[list]
[*] Loneball mode added
[*] AI no longer gives up on a ball too early
[*] AI no longer returns to the middle when the balls are stopped
[*] AI no longer makes huge mistakes when the ball is very close
[*] AI no longer able to rotate the ship more than the player
[*] AI no longer makes sudden small rotations of its ship
[*] AI no longer "shakes" during serves
[*] Fast moving balls no longer tunnel through ships
[*] If ship is moving quickly and passes through a ball - the ball is now reflected back
[*] Shield Power-Up now lasts twice as long! ːsteamhappyː
[*] Fast moving balls no longer miss power-ups when passing through them
[*] Improved the looping of the music by changing the encoding of the audio
[/list]
As always we welcome your comments.

Dark Duo Games

notes.title: DODGEBALL has arrived (v0.1)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/f56ad3892aec949552833f480714845087d763eb.jpg[/img]

We are very excited to release version 0.1. It's such a big deal that we skipped over 0.07, 0.08 and 0.09. There are two major changes in this version:

[olist]

[*] [b]Dodgeball[/b] This is a new game-mode where you must now avoid the balls. Points are earned when your opponent gets hit. However, the balls get faster AND bigger over time. 

[*] [b]Optimsation[/b] We have optimised every aspect of the game and it now runs much, much faster. 

[/olist]

There were also a few minor changes too:

[list]

[*] The game-over screen now requires you to press any button to return to the main menu. (This is especially useful if you want to rub your opponent's nose in the fact that you just utterly, utterly thrashed them.)

[*] Power-Ups are removed after 10 seconds if they are not picked up.

[*] Added instructions for Dodgeball.

[/list]

As always, if you experience any problems with the game then please let us know either in the comments below or via the Discussions.

Happy gaming!

Dark Duo Games

notes.title: Update v0.06 - Little fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/727c611cd3330a78fe10d0150d54bc51e26409c7.jpg[/img]

In this new update we have made a few improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed the AI always missing the last ball.
[*] When selecting "PLAY" for the first time - the input method being used is chosen as Player 1's control type. So, for example, if you click "PLAY" with the mouse then Player 1 will be set to mouse control. If you use a controller, then player 1 will be set to Controller input, and so on.
[*] When there is only one controller connected, if player 1 is using keys or the mouse, player 2 can now use the controller.
[*] Fixed the "Cockpit Camera" - camera was lagging behind.
[*] Changing the camera by pressing Y on the controller no longer skips over available camera views.
[*] The game now has "Full Controller Support" - meaning you can play the game entirely from a controller both normally and in "Big Picture" mode. There is also an official controller configuration for the Steam Controller.
[*] Stopped the music from "dropping out" when lots of samples are playing.
[/list]

We hope you like these improvements. As always, please leave any and all feedback, comments and suggestions here or on the discussions.

Happy gaming.

Dark Duo Games

P.S. ...and yes, the new game mode really, really, really is coming very soon!

notes.title: Version 0.05
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/20a52444783f930aeed6bc1cad4ff4f91afaa2f5.jpg[/img]

Another week, another new version of Impossiball with the following changes: 
[list]
[*]Changed the scoring system so that only balls of your colour score points when put past your opponent.  The previous system can still be played by turning on the new 'Own Goals' option before a game.
[*]Tweaked the AI... again... to make the CPU opponent seem a little less stupid
[*]DPad can now be used to navigate the menus when using a control pad
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse control was lagging in game
[*] Left and right triggers now control the ship rotation along with the right              thumbstick when using a control pad
[*]Added diagram for mouse contols to the controls page
[/list]
If you have any comments, feedback or suggestions about the game then let us know via the Discussions. 

Thanks and happy gaming! 

Dark Duo Games

(*) ...and by "life a little easier" we mean this game. Obviously.

We've just released a new version with the following changes:

[list]
    [*] Tweaked the AI to make the game a little easier.
    [*] When the Steam Overlay is open (via Shift+Tab or the Steam key on the Steam controller) the game is now paused (see screen-shot above).
    [*] Removed the launch window - can now select screen resolution and quality in the Options menu
[/list]

As always, if you have any comments or suggestions about the game then let us know via the Discussions.

Thanks and happy gaming!

Dark Duo Games

notes.title: NEW UPDATE (v0.03) Adds mouse control
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/9ecc1084e446ba0a5877e1cfde2679d540cdf288.png[/img]

[list]
    [*]Added Mouse control - can now move the ship by moving the mouse and rotate it using left and right mouse buttons
    [*]Updated the PLAY menu to allow selection of control method for both players
    [*]You can now skip the DarkDuoGames video by hitting any key
    [*]Improved the look of the score and removed "Player 1" and "Player 2" text - using red and blue background instead
    [*]Tweaked the colours of the stadium floor and walls to make the balls easier to see
    [*]Made the Power-Up text clearer
    [*]Added "LOADING" text between Dark Duo Games logo and main game (rather than a black screen)
    [*]Added scenery outside the stadium to avoid black bars when playing in widescreen and using the "vertical" camera
[/list]

As always, we welcome any and all feedback. If you experience any problems then do let us know.

Happy gaming!

Dark Duo Games

notes.title: First update... Version 0.02
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26306673/1eecb7d2bee08af73b696201b4104f1cb71b780e.png[/img]

We've released our first update!

- Added a new menu option: "CONTROLS" which describes the player control options

- Added a new menu option: "INSTRUCTIONS" which explains the game rules and power-ups

- The winning player is now named on the Game Over screen

Enjoy!

Dark Duo Games
